OBA.1.1.text: This is the vision of Obadiah:
This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom—We have heard a message from the LORD;
an envoy has been sent among the nations
and let us go to battle against her!”—

OBA.1.2.text: “Behold, I will make you small among the nations;

OBA.1.3.text: The pride of your heart has deceived you,
O dwellers in the clefts of the rockswhose habitation is the heights,
‘Who can bring me down to the ground?’

OBA.1.4.text: Though you soar like the eagle
and make your nest among the stars,even from there I will bring you down,”

OBA.1.5.text: oh, how you will be ruined—
would they not steal only what they wanted?
If grape gatherers came to you,
would they not leave some gleanings?

OBA.1.6.text: But how Esau will be pillaged,

OBA.1.7.text: All the men allied with you
will drive you to the border;
the men at peace with you
will set a trap for youwithout your awareness of it.

OBA.1.8.text: In that day, declares the LORD,
will I not destroy the wise men of Edom

OBA.1.9.text: Then your mighty men, O Teman,
so that everyone in the mountains of Esau
will be cut down in the slaughter.

OBA.1.10.text: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob,
you will be covered with shameand cut off forever.

OBA.1.11.text: On the day you stood aloof
while strangers carried off his wealth
and cast lots for Jerusalem,you were just like one of them.

OBA.1.12.text: But you should not gloat in that day,
nor rejoice over the people of Judah
in the day of their destruction,
in the day of their distress.

OBA.1.13.text: You should not enter the gate of My people
in the day of their disaster,
in the day of their disaster,
in the day of their disaster.

OBA.1.14.text: Nor should you stand at the crossroads
in the day of their distress.

OBA.1.15.text: For the Day of the LORD is near
As you have done, it will be done to you;
your recompense will return upon your own head.

OBA.1.16.text: For as you drank on My holy mountain,
so all the nations will drink continually.
They will drink and gulp it down;
they will be as if they had never existed.

OBA.1.17.text: But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance,

OBA.1.18.text: Then the house of Jacob will be a blazing fire,
and the house of Joseph a burning flame;
but the house of Esau will be stubble—
Jacob will set it ablaze and consume it.

OBA.1.19.text: Those from the Negev will possess the mountains of Esau;
those from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines.
They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria,

OBA.1.20.text: And the exiles of this host of the Israelites
will possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath;
and the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad
will possess the cities of the Negev.

OBA.1.21.text: The deliverers will ascend Mount Zion
to rule over the mountains of Esau.
And the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
